Meet the Aston Martin Valen! 

It’s an all-new, V12-powered limited-run Aston, and Mat’s about to find out if it’s one of the coolest Aston Martins ever created. 

Not only will he get to take a look around the exterior and interior, but he’ll also have a chance to spec his own Valen! But before that, let’s look at the standard spec, starting with the exterior…

On first impressions, the Valen is a seriously aggressive piece of kit! The front end is dominated by a huge, aggressive grille that stretches across the length of the car. There’s also a huge front splitter, a vent in the creased bonnet to help with airflow, and thin headlights that sit either side of the iconic S-curve in the front intake.
